description: Start a customer's WEEKLY Well Prepped Life meal delivery — a standing order that repeats every week until they pause or cancel. No payment is taken here. It also creates their customer account: the confirmation email carries a one-tap link to set a password, after which they can change plans, pick next week's meals, edit or cancel the order and pay invoices at wellpreppedlife.com/account. Justine confirms the menu with them within 24 hours. Before calling: use get_menu, confirm the plan, the meals (picking plans), the first drop-off time from get_delivery_times, the delivery city, and the customer's name plus email (and phone if they'll share it). After it succeeds, give them the weekly billing link it returns so the weekly charge is set up.

carb_swap.description: coordinated only: replace the dish's carb with one of get_menu's carb options.

city.description: Delivery city. Must be one of the served cities in get_menu; anything else is taken as a waitlist order.

contact_pref.description: How they'd like Justine to reach them.

dietary.description: Dietary-need ids from get_menu (e.g. diabetic-friendly, kidney-friendly, low-sodium-heart, softer-textures).

dropoff_day.description: First drop-off day, YYYY-MM-DD, exactly as returned by get_delivery_times.

dropoff_min.description: First drop-off time, minutes after midnight Pacific, exactly as returned by get_delivery_times.

email.description: Customer's email — the order confirmation and account set-up link go here.

items.description: Dish picks for coordinated / personalChef: slugs from get_menu with portion counts in multiples of 3, totalling at least the plan's minimum. Leave empty for foundation.

qty.description: Portions of this dish — a multiple of 3.

meals_per_week.description: foundation only: meals per week if they want more than the standard week (multiple of 3).

notes.description: Allergies, dislikes, gate codes, access notes, anything else for Justine.

phone.description: Customer's phone (recommended; drop-off reminders are texted).

plan.description: Plan id from get_menu. foundation = chef's choice (no picks); coordinated = choose your meals (the usual choice); personalChef = custom menu with Justine.

start_pref.description: Only if they could not pick a drop-off time: roughly when to start.

veg_swap.description: coordinated only: replace the dish's vegetable with one of get_menu's vegetable options.

name: place_order
title: Start weekly meal delivery
